The 'text_gibberish' observation by the Router is critical; the Router correctly flagged this as an artifact, whereas the checkpoints do not explicitly cover surface markings.

The 'text_gibberish' is a definitive sign of AI generation, preventing a perfect artifact score.

While the structure is solid (high topology confidence), these surface-level artifacts prevent a high artifact score. It is significantly better than the 'low' reference (bannister) but worse than the 'high' reference (rifle) due to the text artifact.
